xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:title: CUI, tailored for the CHP server
xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:description:
Extends xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_cui with two documented deviations, on the CHP server (owner decisions 2026-11-20). Each unselected rule carries its own reason below.
1. chronyd_client_only. Owner decision 2026-11-20: the CHP server serves time to the site LAN only (chrony allow <site subnet>, bindaddress SERVER_IP, firewalld 123/udp from the site subnet); workstations sync from it and never from outside sources. The server's chrony therefore does not keep the profile's client-only setting (port 0). Workstations keep the stock profile, where this rule stays selected and passes.
2. sysctl_user_max_user_namespaces. The reason, quoted from the deviation's record (docs/dc2-planning/dc2-cui-tailoring.xml, the tailoring the ISO proofs scan with, lab/iso5/DEVIATIONS.md): "The base "cui" profile sets user.max_user_namespaces = 0. On dc2 this conflicts with systemd's own unit-level sandboxing (PrivateUsers=true/yes, used by stock RHEL 9 irqbalance.service and upower.service, plus GNOME session helper units), which requires the ability to create at least one user namespace per sandboxed service and fails with ENOSPC when the kernel-wide limit is 0." The CHP installer carries the same deviation on every host: the kickstart's %post removes the profile's user.max_user_namespaces setting and rebuilds the initramfs (appliance/kickstart/chp.ks.in).
